data.summary: All 13 tasks implemented and verified against the real diff rather than the reports. 196 desktop tests, 0 failures, run with forced --rerun-tasks per module so the F-2 all-UP-TO-DATE failure mode could not recur. The audit raised 15 findings (0 error, 4 warn); the one real defect-class find was fixed before close. Scope is clean across 23 source files with zero leakage from F-3, F-5, F-6, F-7 or F-8, and zero build-file edits.

waivers.reason: Both carry verificationMethod=test from the PRD, but this repo has ZERO Compose UI tests and this host cannot load Skiko in-process (ImageBitmap(2,3) throws LibraryLoadException), so the dashed border, ruler ticks, scrim, autofocus and delete affordance are asserted by no automated test. Satisfied by pure plus reducer tests plus previews and a demo. The mismatch is inherited from upstream, not a shortcut taken here; adopt-compose-ui-test is filed as a follow-up.

Nothing visual is asserted anywhere in this spec. No window was rendered, no screenshot taken. That is an environment limit (no UI-test harness, no in-process Skiko, screen capture denied), recorded rather than worked around. SC-4's screenshot is still owed.
Plan step 11's parity pass and the frozen-frame fps check are screenshot and demo work no agent could perform here. Previews exist for both themes; neither was rendered.

CommentPopover carries FOUR hardcoded Color values (the audit corrected the orchestrator's count of three), pre-existing in commit 38b415a with a documented always-dark rationale. Not an F-4 defect - this spec added none of them - but this spec did extend the file. Routed to design-tokens.md as an explicit carve-out rather than a silent inheritance.
The threshold is required in BOTH axes. The spec named MIN_DRAG_DEVICE_PX but not the conjunction; AND was chosen because a 400x2 rect selects nothing a user meant, and documented.

openChangeRequests.note: 11 info findings carried as follow-ups, including the ceremonial awaitEachGesture body in the pointer shield and the unshielded gutter popovers.

Inherited and still open from earlier specs: resultLauncher catches CancellationException repo-wide; F-2's SEC-1 (GetProp takes unvalidated free text into adb shell with zero production callers); the E-resize cursor needing expect/actual; the missing onPop token; six module README tables.
